visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Call super Instead of Repeating Its Text
visualizerParams.problemDescription: LoudGreeter repeats the word Hello from Greeter instead of using the parent's method. Build on super.greet(). The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: If the text in Greeter changes, the copy in LoudGreeter silently stays the old one. Calling super.greet() keeps the subclass in step with its parent.
